October 30

Of Henry George

By Richard Watson Gilder (1844–1909)

N
OW
 is the city great! That deep-voiced bell
Tolls for a martyred hero. Such is he
Who loved her, strove for her, and nobly fell.
His fire be ours,—the passion to be free.
